title: SHA-256 Hash Generator
description: Hash text with SHA-256 in your browser and copy the hex digest. Uses the Web Crypto API. The input is never uploaded.
intro: Type or paste text and generate a SHA-256 hex digest locally. Useful for checksums of notes, tokens and short files you paste as text.
blurb: Compute a SHA-256 hex digest of text entirely in the browser.
howItWorks: Paste the exact text, including spaces and line breaks.
Press Generate SHA-256. The browser hashes the UTF-8 bytes with SubtleCrypto.
Copy the 64-character lowercase hex digest. The same text always produces the same digest.
examples: The word toolnova has a stable SHA-256 hex digest you can recompute any time.
Adding a trailing space changes the digest because the bytes change.
An empty box hashes the empty string, which is a known SHA-256 value.

faq.a: No. It is a one-way hash. You cannot recover the original text from the digest.
It hashes the text you paste, encoded as UTF-8. For a file checksum, paste the file contents only if they are text.

faq.q: Will the result match other tools?
faq.a: Yes, when those tools hash the same UTF-8 bytes. Watch for hidden newlines added by editors.
